address: 21/3 Mu 4, Mueang Phang-nga-Takua Pa Road, Thung Kha Ngok, Mueang Phang-nga, Phang-Nga, 82000, Thailand
bio: For over 20 years, locals have enjoyed this shop’s Khanom Jeen, or rice noodles, which are served with a choice of three curries and more than 20 types of fresh or pickled veggies. Noodles are unlimited, but save room for the refreshing cendol in coconut milk. Closed Thursday and Friday....
